# Binding table (generated by tools/bindings.py)

Per node of the phone's board tree that has a `compatible`: is there a driver matching that
string in the 6.12 trees (GKI, soc-repo, bsp612/techpacks, samsung612, drivers612, modules)?
"driver in 6.12" means the of_match string exists; property parsing was NOT compared
automatically (see README, section Binding review, for the nodes checked by hand).

| Subsystem | nodes with a 6.12 driver | nodes without |
|---|---|---|
| sec-platform | 2 | 11 |
| power | 5 | 1 |
| misc | 6 | 11 |
| input | 1 | 1 |
| sensors | 1 | 2 |
| secure | 0 | 1 |
| pmic | 23 | 7 |
| camera | 6 | 22 |
| audio | 32 | 1 |
| display | 1 | 0 |
| nfc | 0 | 2 |
| memory | 6 | 3 |
| touch | 1 | 3 |
| usb | 1 | 0 |
